canonical: Acquisition OS → Canonical OS Color Palette → Every future WAVES OS
mode: dark is truth, light is fallback

background.purpose: Primary background — app shell, page canvas, header/sidebar base

foreground.purpose: Primary text — headings, body, high-contrast content

card.purpose: Secondary/surface — cards, panels, sidebar, header surfaces

card-hover.purpose: Elevated surface — card hover, secondary background, hover/active surfaces

primary.purpose: Primary action background — primary buttons (light on dark)

secondary.purpose: Secondary action background — secondary buttons, muted controls

muted.purpose: Muted background — inputs, subtle surfaces, disabled backgrounds

muted-foreground.purpose: Secondary/muted text — descriptions, placeholders, table headers, secondary info

text-secondary.purpose: Secondary text — alternative muted text, slightly lighter than muted-foreground

text-faint.purpose: Faint text — disabled, captions, very subtle

accent.purpose: Primary accent — interactive, links, success, focus, glow, active states

accent-secondary.purpose: Secondary accent — violet, alternative accent, charts, badges

destructive.purpose: Error/destructive — errors, delete actions, destructive buttons, error states

border.purpose: Borders/dividers — card borders, dividers, input borders

border-strong.purpose: Strong borders — hover borders, emphasized dividers

ring.purpose: Focus ring — keyboard focus, accent ring

semanticMapping.primaryAccent: accent (173 84% 42% #11C5B0) — also success, hover/active, ring, glow
semanticMapping.warning: 38 92% 50% #F59E0B (extended, not in Acquisition OS core — use for warning states, mapped to --warn in consuming OS)

usage.tailwind: hsl(var(--border)) via tailwind.config.ts theme.extend.colors.border DEFAULT hsl(var(--border)) etc
usage.tradeOsMigration: D:\trade-os\src\app\globals.css — copied Acquisition OS :root/.dark verbatim + Trade OS aliases (--panel → card etc) + layout.tsx class="dark" + pages hsl(var(--...))
